# modal-toolkit

> The operator CLI for the Modal Toolkit. Deployed with `mtk` from a project overlay. Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/modal-toolkit/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): from a new project to a deployed mtk package.
- [How-to](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/modal-toolkit/blob/main/docs/how-to.md): day-to-day operation.

## Toolkit

- [Modal Toolkit](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/modal-toolkit): the operator CLI (`mtk`) and the full family.
